name: v0.2.2-rc.2
body:
[中文](#cn-v0.2.2-rc.2) | [English](#en-v0.2.2-rc.2)

新增功能

- Git Worktree 支持按分支、提交和文件类型审阅改动，并直接处理 GitHub 评审、同步已审阅进度和更新分支。 @LegGasai - SubAgent 支持具名与多层协作，AgentTeam 可按会话开启，共用成员与任务面板。 @Dudu-0223, @Yifffan - 桌面端支持在设置中切换正式版与开发版更新渠道。 @winewill ### 体验优化 - 改善代码审阅时的评论、文件导航与窄屏布局，减少查看大型改动时的卡顿，并放宽大型仓库创建工作树的等待时间。 @LegGasai - 改善多层子代理的浏览与任务协调，优先展示任务描述，支持逐层展开和读取失败后重试。 @Dudu-0223 - 优化左侧栏插件入口的收纳，不常用入口可移入“更多”，重新固定时保持原顺序。 @Yifffan - 简化个性化页面安装后的操作，移除“保留”按钮，统一使用撤销与恢复。 @ZiyaZhang - 改善自定义主题对通知、卡片、计划和任务等界面颜色的覆盖。 @turtle2099 - 改善页面缩放、平移及长列表场景下的菜单定位，保持菜单与触发位置对齐；自定义浮层需适配新定位接口。 @Stevring, @LegGasai - 改善暗色模式下文件树浮层的显示，使用背景层次区分面板，避免白色投影。 @turtle2099 - 改善在侧栏查找文件的体验，支持按名称或路径搜索，并可调整排除规则与隐藏文件显示。 @yudshj - 改善侧栏长列表的浏览与拖动体验，插件导航和会话列表共用滚动区域，工作区工具栏保持可见。 @Yifffan - 优化从会话打开工作目录的操作，统一“在应用中打开”菜单，并改善窄屏使用体验。 @Yifffan - 加快文件右键菜单的打开；关联应用查询较慢时，先提供默认应用入口。 @yudshj - 向上回看聊天时自动加载更早消息，优先保持阅读位置，并保留手动加载和重试入口。 @imccyu - 改善聊天过程的可查看性，可展开工作区指令、技能目录等信息，了解模型收到的上下文。 @turtle2099 - 改善补丁编辑的回执，折叠状态下也可查看修改的文件，并在成功后直接打开。 @sjw1231 - 优化会话首页的交互动画。 @ZiyaZhang - 改善会话恢复或压缩后的上下文提示，明确当前运行信息与旧信息的替换关系。 @kermanx - 改善聊天中代码差异的阅读，显示增删行颜色，并按文件语言高亮。 @mektpoy - 改善粘贴图片和文件的体验，未聚焦输入框时也可粘贴到最近使用的可用输入框或主对话。 @std4453 - 改善暂停、恢复定时任务时的操作反馈，保持按钮焦点与显示稳定，避免重复操作。 @turtle2099 - 优化目标栏的操作排列与按钮间距，统一为“编辑、清除、暂停或恢复”。 @turtle2099 - 优化模型请求失败后的重试设置，可在模型设置中选择重试条件、次数和等待时间。 @turtle2099 - 改善临时请求失败后的恢复操作，可直接点击“继续生成”，无需另写消息。 @LegGasai - 改善 API Key 的管理，已保存密钥以掩码显示，支持整体替换或清除，不显示完整旧密钥。 @Magolor - 优化多问题检索，单次网页搜索默认支持最多 10 个查询和 10 个来源。 @turtle2099 - 改善 Agent 终端的可见性与接管体验，命令在侧栏终端运行，用户输入即可接管；允许读取的用户终端内容会进入模型与会话记录。 @LegGasai - 优化批量查询文件、任务和资源时的执行效率，更多只读工具可并行运行，结果仍按调用顺序返回。 @turtle2099 - 改善桌面更新下载时的进度显示，可点击下载百分比或“检查更新”查看状态。 @winewill ### 问题修复 - 修复 PR 更新后审阅差异与提交行号不一致的问题，并改善大量评审讨论的统计。 @LegGasai - 修复只有 SSH 凭据时无法查看私有 Git 插件详情的问题。 @turtle2099 - 修复可选插件加载失败导致整个 Web 页面无法启动的问题；必需插件失败仍会提示。 @imccyu - 修复已启用但未成功加载的插件容易被误认为正在运行的问题，明确显示“未运行”及原因。 @turtle1999 - 修复 PTC 中重复等待子代理消息时，同一条消息反复触发唤醒的问题。 @Dudu-0223 - 修复浏览特殊文件名或扩展名时，文件树视图崩溃的问题。 @LegGasai - 修复“未分组”会话中显示无效“新建会话”按钮的问题。 @turtle2099 - 修复复制聊天公式时出现乱码的问题，同一条 Markdown 内容中的公式可复制为 TeX 源码。 @turtle2099 - 修复查看 Perl 代码时，正则表达式导致后续内容高亮错误的问题。 @turtle2099 - 修复聊天更新出错后，历史加载和新消息显示持续卡住的问题。 @Magolor - 改善重复创建会话分支时的标题编号，跳过已用编号，减少同名会话。 @turtle2099 - 修复停止任务或关闭会话时，部分错误导致任务未中止或资源提前释放的问题。 @liukx0205 - 修复发送消息或准备附件期间重试请求，导致同一消息被重复提交的问题。 @liukx0205 - 修复中文目标栏混淆“待继续”与“已暂停”状态的问题。 @imccyu - 修复桌面端多次启动后，因鉴权信息累积而无法启动的问题。 @turtle2099 - 修复 Windows 通过短路径启动命令行时，无法保存欢迎页确认的问题。 @winewill - 修复 macOS 窗口拖动与粘贴快捷键问题，以及 Windows 暗色模式启动白闪。 @yxy72, @winewill, @turtle2099 - 改善 Windows 更新安装期间的反馈，显示安装状态窗口，减少重启过程中的无提示等待。 @winewill - 修复移动端 Safari 在展开屏幕或切换视口后，聊天文字被额外放大的问题，保留用户主动缩放。 @Saafo - 修复 Linux 存在长期后台进程时，会话加载与新建变慢的问题。 @turtle2099 - 修复会话中移除或替换工具后，部分模型拒绝继续请求的问题。 @Tuyixiang - 通过 Anthropic Messages 接入时，历史前缀变化后省略失效的签名 thinking，减少压缩后持续请求失败。 @turtle2099 - 修复部分模型网关错误被误报为“API 密钥无效”的问题，使重试按实际响应状态处理。 @LegGasai - 修复在 DSH 用户目录中配置 DeepSeek 端点后无法启动的问题；项目目录中的环境配置仍不能覆盖端点。 @LegGasai - 修复连续浏览多页 PDF 时加载越来越慢、快速翻页卡顿的问题。 @turtle2099 - 修复使用 Inspector 查看较大的 Cordis 树时，快照接近上限可能导致服务退出的问题。 @turtle2099 ### 其他变更 - 网页搜索默认改用 DeepSeek Search API，搜索与获取可分别选择计费账号或 API Key；旧提供方和自定义配置需按升级指南调整。 @yudshj - 归档会话默认清理符合条件的 Git 工作树，保留分支与提交；需保留本地目录时请关闭清理，自定义配置与 Forge 插件需迁移。 @LegGasai - AgentTeam 改用统一的具名子代理，中断工具默认关闭；自定义插件与 SDK 集成需迁移，共享会话的进程须同步升级。 @Dudu-0223 - SDK 可通过配置为新会话默认开启团队协作，恢复已有会话时保留原选择。 @Dudu-0223 - 允许插件动态注册和移除 MCP 服务，并查询状态、重启或探测连接，无需用户逐项维护服务配置。 @LegGasai - 插件可按语言扩展聊天代码块的显示，未匹配或渲染失败时回退为普通代码块。 @imccyu - 插件索引可提供 GitHub Star 和 npm 周下载量，默认仍按索引提供的顺序排列。 @turtle1999 - Creator 的开发指引统一到 dsh-doc，用于定制 DSH 并查阅当前版本资料；引用旧技能名称或路径的扩展需迁移。 @turtle1999 - 自定义模型提供方支持 Gemini 原生接口，可获取模型列表并设置推理等级。 @turtle2099 - 模型请求的 User-Agent 增加启动配置标记，便于服务端区分桌面端、Web、命令行与 SDK 请求。 @imccyu - 调整账号通知，支持产品公告等消息并随界面语言更新；已有登录保留，自定义账号插件与配置需迁移。 @lsdsjy - PTC 按运行时限限制工具调用总量，超限会终止代码并清空保留状态，已完成的操作不会撤销。 @kermanx - Session 支持批量追加事件，日志格式不变；自定义追加接口的包装代码需适配批量调用。 @liukx0205 - 工具失败提供更明确的错误类型与代码，便于定位问题；依赖旧错误分类的插件和 SDK 集成需同步适配。 @sjw1231 - 调整 Computer Use 的窗口操作、键盘控制和授权，默认不移动系统鼠标；自定义脚本与 helper 需同步升级。 @CreatixChu, @Tuyixiang, @Dudu-0223 - Office 改用原生工具，Web 与 SDK 均可加载技能；旧包和技能需迁移，文档解析在 DSH 主进程中运行，不受命令行沙箱保护。 @yudshj - Windows 的额外目录授权仅供文件工具使用，不扩大终端或 PTC 的访问范围；相关沙箱扩展需迁移。 @Tuyixiang - 调整 LiveShare 的多会话分享与插件授权，旧授权需重新配置；PTC 可访问分享目录之外，仅应分享给可信任的人。 @mektpoy - npm 安装与桌面端随附对应版本的源码和文档，方便查阅与开发扩展；Python 单文件运行时不包含这些资源。 @turtle1999 - 升级 Zod 至 4.6.6、Stagehand 至 4.4.0；Stagehand 改为自动发现扩展，旧 extensionId 配置不再生效。 @imccyu

New Features

- Git Worktree supports reviewing changes by branch, commit, and file category, with GitHub reviews, synchronized viewed-file progress, and branch updates directly in DSH. by @LegGasai - SubAgent supports named, multi-level collaboration, while AgentTeam can be enabled per session with a shared member and task panel. by @Dudu-0223, @Yifffan - Desktop settings now let you switch between stable and development update channels. by @winewill ### Improvements - Improve commenting, file navigation, and narrow-screen layouts during code review, reduce lag when viewing large changes, and allow more time to create worktrees in large repositories. by @LegGasai - Improve browsing and coordinating nested subagents, prioritizing task descriptions and supporting incremental expansion and retries after failed reads. by @Dudu-0223 - Improve sidebar plugin organization: move infrequently used entries into More and restore them without changing their original order. by @Yifffan - Simplify actions after installing personalized pages, replacing Keep with Undo and Restore. by @ZiyaZhang - Improve custom-theme coverage for notifications, cards, plans, tasks, and other interface colors. by @turtle2099 - Improve menu positioning during page zooming, panning, and browsing long lists, keeping menus aligned with their triggers; custom panels need to adopt the new positioning API. by @Stevring, @LegGasai - Improve dark-theme file-tree panels with layered backgrounds instead of white shadows. by @turtle2099 - Improve file discovery in the sidebar with name and path search, exclusion rules, and hidden-file controls. by @yudshj - Improve browsing and dragging in long sidebar lists, with plugin navigation and sessions sharing a scroll area and workspace controls remaining visible. by @Yifffan - Streamline opening a session's working directory through a consistent Open in menu, with improved narrow-screen usability. by @Yifffan - Open file context menus faster; when application lookup is slow, offer a default-app action first. by @yudshj - Automatically load earlier messages when scrolling up through chat, prioritizing reading-position stability while retaining manual loading and retry controls. by @imccyu - Make chat activity easier to inspect by expanding workspace instructions, skill catalogs, and other context received by the model. by @turtle2099 - Improve patch-edit receipts by listing affected files even when collapsed and allowing them to be opened after successful edits. by @sjw1231 - Improve interaction animations on the session home screen. by @ZiyaZhang - Improve context reminders after session resume or compaction by clarifying how current runtime information replaces older information. by @kermanx - Improve reading code diffs in chat with added and removed row colors and per-file syntax highlighting. by @mektpoy - Improve image and file pasting without a focused composer, routing content to the most recently used available composer or the main conversation. by @std4453 - Improve feedback when pausing or resuming scheduled tasks, keeping focus and appearance stable while preventing duplicate actions. by @turtle2099 - Refine goal-bar action order and spacing to Edit, Clear, and Pause or Resume. by @turtle2099 - Improve model-request retry settings with configurable retry conditions, counts, and wait times in model settings. by @turtle2099 - Make recovery from transient request failures easier with Continue generating, without requiring another message. by @LegGasai - Improve API-key management with masked previews and full replacement or removal, without revealing the complete saved key. by @Magolor - Improve multi-question research with up to 10 queries and 10 sources per web-search call by default. by @turtle2099 - Make Agent terminals visible in the sidebar and let users take over by typing; user-terminal content that agents are permitted to read enters model context and session records. by @LegGasai - Improve batch file, task, and resource queries by allowing more read-only tools to run concurrently while returning results in call order. by @turtle2099 - Improve Desktop update progress displays, with status available from the download percentage or Check for updates. by @winewill ### Bug Fixes - Fix PR updates causing displayed diffs to use mismatched commit line numbers, and improve counts for large numbers of review threads. by @LegGasai - Fix private Git plugin details failing to load for users with SSH-only credentials. by @turtle2099 - Fix optional plugin failures preventing the entire Web app from starting; required-plugin failures remain visible errors. by @imccyu - Fix enabled but unloaded plugins appearing to run, clearly showing Not running and the reason. by @turtle1999 - Fix repeated waits for subagent messages within PTC waking repeatedly for the same message. by @Dudu-0223 - Fix file-tree crashes when browsing special filenames or extensions. by @LegGasai - Fix a nonfunctional New Session button appearing in the Ungrouped session header. by @turtle2099 - Fix garbled formula copying in chat, copying formulas within a single Markdown document as TeX source. by @turtle2099 - Fix Perl regular expressions incorrectly coloring subsequent code. by @turtle2099 - Fix history loading and new-message displays remaining stuck after a chat-update error. by @Magolor - Improve title numbering when repeatedly branching a session, skipping used numbers to reduce duplicate names. by @turtle2099 - Fix some errors during task cancellation or session shutdown leaving work running or releasing resources prematurely. by @liukx0205 - Fix retried requests during message submission or attachment preparation submitting the same message more than once. by @liukx0205 - Fix the Chinese goal bar confusing goals awaiting continuation with paused goals. by @imccyu - Fix accumulated authentication data preventing Desktop startup after repeated launches. by @turtle2099 - Fix welcome-screen confirmation failing to save when the Windows CLI is launched through a short path. by @winewill - Fix macOS window dragging and paste shortcuts, and white flashes when starting Windows in dark mode. by @yxy72, @winewill, @turtle2099 - Improve feedback during Windows update installation with an installation-status window, reducing unexplained waiting during restarts. by @winewill - Fix mobile Safari enlarging chat text beyond the configured font size when unfolding or changing the viewport, while preserving manual page zoom. by @Saafo - Fix long-running background processes slowing session loading and creation on Linux. by @turtle2099 - Fix some models rejecting further requests after tools are removed or replaced in a session. by @Tuyixiang - For Anthropic Messages connections, omit invalid signed thinking after history-prefix changes to reduce persistent request failures after compaction. by @turtle2099 - Fix some model-gateway failures being misreported as invalid API keys, allowing retries to follow the actual response status. by @LegGasai - Fix startup failure after configuring DeepSeek endpoints in the DSH user directory; project environment settings still cannot override these endpoints. by @LegGasai - Fix progressively slower loading and rapid-page-navigation stalls when browsing multi-page PDFs. by @turtle2099 - Fix inspecting large Cordis trees potentially terminating the service when snapshots approach the size limit. by @turtle2099 ### Chores - Web search now defaults to DeepSeek Search API, with separate account or API-key billing choices for Search and Fetch; migrate older providers and custom settings using the upgrade guide. by @yudshj - Archiving sessions cleans up eligible Git worktrees by default while preserving branches and commits; disable cleanup to retain local directories, and migrate custom configuration and Forge plugins. by @LegGasai - AgentTeam uses unified named subagents, with the interrupt tool disabled by default; migrate custom plugins and SDK integrations and upgrade all processes sharing session storage together. by @Dudu-0223 - SDK configuration can enable Team collaboration by default for new sessions while preserving the saved choice when resuming existing sessions. by @Dudu-0223 - Plugins can dynamically register and remove MCP servers, query their status, restart them, and probe connections without requiring users to maintain each server configuration manually. by @LegGasai - Plugins can extend chat code-block rendering by language, falling back to ordinary code blocks when no renderer matches or rendering fails. by @imccyu - Plugin indexes can provide GitHub stars and weekly npm downloads while keeping the order supplied by the index as the default. by @turtle1999 - Creator guidance consolidates into dsh-doc for customizing DSH and consulting current-version resources; extensions referencing old skill names or paths need migration. by @turtle1999 - Custom model providers support the native Gemini API, including model discovery and reasoning-level settings. by @turtle2099 - Model-request User-Agent headers include the active profile, helping servers distinguish Desktop, Web, CLI, and SDK requests. by @imccyu - Account notifications support announcements and refresh with the interface language; existing sign-ins are retained, while custom account plugins and configuration need migration. by @lsdsjy - PTC limits total tool calls according to its runtime budget; exceeding the limit terminates the code and clears retained state without undoing completed operations. by @kermanx - Session supports batched event appends without changing the log format; custom append wrappers need to support batch calls. by @liukx0205 - Tool failures provide clearer error types and codes for diagnosis; plugins and SDK integrations relying on older classifications need updating. by @sjw1231 - Adjust Computer Use window operations, keyboard control, and authorization, keeping the system pointer still by default; upgrade custom scripts and helpers together. by @CreatixChu, @Tuyixiang, @Dudu-0223 - Office uses native tools, with skills available in Web and SDK sessions; migrate old packages and skills. Document parsing runs in the DSH host process outside the shell sandbox. by @yudshj - Windows extra-directory grants apply only to file tools, not terminal or PTC access; related sandbox extensions need migration. by @Tuyixiang - Adjust LiveShare multi-session sharing and plugin authorization; reconfigure old grants. PTC can access files outside the shared directory, so share only with trusted people. by @mektpoy - npm installations and Desktop include matching source code and documentation for reference and extension development; Python single-file runtimes exclude these resources. by @turtle1999 - Upgrade Zod to 4.6.6 and Stagehand to 4.4.0; Stagehand automatically discovers extensions, and the old extensionId setting no longer takes effect. by @imccyu Full Changelog: https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/compare/dsh-v0.2.2-rc.1...dsh-v0.2.2-rc.2

name: v0.2.2-rc.1
body:
[中文](#cn-v0.2.2-rc.1-5) | [English](#en-v0.2.2-rc.1-5) 作为 0.2.2 系列的首个候选版本，本版本汇总了自 v0.2.1-rc.5 以来的主要用户和开发者相关变更。

新增功能

- 完善手机和平板适配，优化软键盘交互、导航与窄屏布局，保持菜单和操作入口可用。 @Stevring, @turtle2099, @LegGasai, @EricMoin, @Saafo - 支持将聊天文本作为引用插入输入框，并在发送后显示紧凑预览。 @lsdsjy, @imccyu - 支持将完整历史会话复制为 Markdown，包含可用的原始日志路径。 @tianyicui - 工作步骤收起后保留全部助手文字回复，可切换为仅最终回答。 @imccyu - 支持统一右键与键盘菜单，覆盖会话、工作区和侧边栏，并支持开发者扩展。 @std4453 - 文件预览支持常驻目录树和文件定位功能。 @yudshj - 新增日语、西班牙语、法语、德语、俄语和巴西葡萄牙语文案与界面配置。 @07akioni - 插件管理页支持展示富文本详情，并改善页面布局和导航行为。 @turtle1999, @turtle2099 - 插件管理支持更新第三方插件包；热更新失败时会尝试恢复旧版本。 @turtle1999, @turtle2099 - 同名工作区在选择器中显示最短区分路径后缀，窄屏优先保留后缀。 @turtle2099 - 会话列表支持插件图标，并改善键盘与触屏操作。 @LegGasai - 侧栏会话悬浮卡显示工作目录，便于区分未分组或同名会话。 @turtle2099 - 优化侧栏空间布局，改善响应区域，平滑搜索框展开与收起。 @Yifffan - 侧栏搜索支持不区分大小写的会话 ID 子串匹配。 @turtle2099 - Reduce content and scroll jumps while keeping running status visible. by @imccyu - Show full truncated composer statistics in tooltips and include turn and step counts in Session statistics. by @turtle2099 - Briefly highlight and fade the target line in code and text previews after opening a file-line link from chat. by @turtle2099 - Pan images that exceed the viewport and transfer original files through in-app drag-and-drop or native desktop dragging. by @std4453 - Add raw JSON views of live tool results to Trajectory, displayed above rendered results. by @kermanx - Fold Trajectory subcalls independently while keeping their parent calls and summaries visible. Reveal matching subcalls through search or cross-view navigation. by @kermanx - Start the model picker with configured models selected, add or remove candidates while preserving custom values, and apply select-all only to visible candidates. by @turtle2099 - For models accessed through pi-ai that cannot accept additional system messages during a conversation, keep later system messages in place as reminders rather than moving them into the initial prompt. by @Tuyixiang - Reorder models within DeepSeek and pi-ai providers by dragging or using arrow keys, preserving order and complete model parameters when saved. by @Magolor - Clear all inactive automation tasks in one confirmed action while keeping active tasks. by @Chinesezjc - Search prioritizes long Search API summaries for models, capped at 800 characters per source by default, while search cards retain short snippets. by @yudshj - Improve history-context cache reuse across consecutive tool calls in Auto review to reduce repeated processing. by @turtle2099 - Background-job completion notices include small outputs and reduce duplicate notifications for already-read results and subagent closing messages. by @turtle1999 - Reduce sleeping and repeated polling in subagent guidance: end the current turn when only a result remains pending and wait for its completion notification. by @Chinesezjc - Speed up file searches with literal directory prefixes by skipping unrelated directories while preserving results and ordering. by @kermanx - Deliver ordinary Word edits after saving and checking content and formatting, without unnecessary ZIP, XML, or metadata inspection. by @tianyicui - Enable WebSocket compression for remote connections by default to reduce transfers of large message histories; disable it with `websocketCompression`. by @imccyu - Web static assets support ETag revalidation, returning 304 for unchanged files to avoid repeated downloads. by @imccyu - Reduce repeated publications and catalog processing during Session state updates, and lower runtime overhead when assembling streaming replies. by @liukx0205, @imccyu - Improve system and application permission onboarding for macOS Computer Use. Request system permissions through a standalone app with system-settings and drag-in guidance, and refresh permission status on return. Support long clicks, improve application launching, and retain application permissions across restarts. by @CreatixChu, @koalazf99 ### Bug Fixes - Budget global and project AGENTS.md chains separately so project instructions do not evict global guidance; messages containing both chains can use up to twice maxBytes. by @ZiyaZhang - Compact history with the previous model before switching to a smaller context window; stop the switch request and preserve its previous header if compaction fails. by @Dudu-0223 - Preserve the required thought signatures in Gemini tool calls over OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions and include them in subsequent requests to prevent rejection caused by missing signatures. by @turtle2099 - Reuse existing context-prefix caches for new model requests when the system prompt is unchanged, avoiding unnecessary cache invalidation. by @mektpoy - Continue pi-ai conversations that exceed the request image-count limit by offloading the oldest images, preventing repeated failures. by @turtle2099 - Hide Web search tools when required credentials are missing; fetch tools using the newer Web API also follow credential readiness. by @LegGasai - Preserve saved Auto permission and approval policy during application shutdown instead of unintentionally switching to Full access. by @tianyicui - Fix Auto review failures before tool execution on OpenCode routes by supplying the reviewed Session identity and request purpose. by @LegGasai - User steering now releases a background-output wait immediately and returns current output without stopping the job. by @mektpoy - Fix delegation tools being temporarily unavailable after preset round trips and apply the current Agent’s tool restrictions to delegation. by @Dudu-0223 - Resume blocked goals from the Web goal bar; goals that have exhausted their round limit still require a higher limit first. by @turtle2099 - Preselect every recommended option in multiple-choice questions instead of only the first, while preserving single-choice and answered-card behavior. by @yudshj - Approval messages explicitly state whether user approval is requested, avoiding ambiguity around the never policy. by @turtle2099 - Prevent history expansion from rewriting exclamation marks or causing persistent Bash command timeouts on macOS. by @grllll - Tell the model to continue after a skipped question without asking it again or treating the skip as permission. by @turtle2099 - Keep skills from healthy roots available when another skill root cannot be read, and report incomplete discovery. by @Dudu-0223 - Allow Web Fetch to read valid UTF-8 pages whose encoding declarations contain multiple labels including UTF-8. by @Dudu-0223 - Fix tool calls failing on unambiguous optional arguments by accepting an empty grep include. by @turtle1999 - Expand and collapse long questions and option descriptions in place, with navigation and submission controls kept visible. by @yudshj - Save Session recovery records before model requests and tool execution in `sdk-minimal`. Stop related operations if saving fails to improve recovery after short Sessions are interrupted. by @LogosVeritas - Pause the chat running clock during disconnection or reconnection and resume elapsed-time display after reconnecting. by @turtle2099 - Keep retained steering and follow-up input in log order before assistant output in Trajectory, including after refresh and history loading. by @kermanx - Run ordinary conversation forks independently instead of treating them as subagents, while preserving creator relationships for real subagents. by @Dudu-0223 - Restore opening historical Sessions with older subagent descriptors and fix the resulting Session search failures. by @turtle2099 - Fix chat history loading and live updates getting stuck after loading earlier compacted history. by @turtle2099 - Expand leading ~ or ~/ in local file tools to the Host home directory while preserving literal tildes elsewhere in paths. by @turtle2099 - Resolve relative chat file links from the Session working directory at click time so worktree Sessions do not open the original checkout. by @turtle2099 - Keep single tildes literal in Markdown and require double tildes for strikethrough. by @turtle2099 - Show the current local Markdown image in newly rendered messages and previews after the file is overwritten. by @turtle2099 - Fix bare URLs incorrectly including following Chinese punctuation and text in links. by @turtle2099 - Preserve backslash separators in Windows-path Markdown links and images so they resolve to the intended location. by @turtle2099 - Include whole-turn deliveries and writes in deliverable cards and closing-reply file links, even after the reply; present guidance tells agents to link files before waiting for user input. by @yudshj - Fix prolonged page freezes caused by syntax highlighting of certain struct definitions. by @yudshj - Fix pasted file and folder paths being highlighted only through their directory prefixes in the composer. by @turtle2099 - Preserve the sidebar file-tab strip's scroll position when selecting, opening, or closing tabs instead of restarting from the left edge. by @turtle2099 - Use isolated, theme-backed sidebar drag previews to avoid capturing content behind rows while preserving native reordering. by @Stevring - Make settings-navigation hover visible in dark mode while retaining selected-state priority. by @turtle2099 - Accept line ranges and line/column suffixes in Markdown file links, open the file when a location is invalid, and retain URLs as web links. by @kermanx - Retain reading position in text and Markdown previews across refreshes and temporary file shortening instead of jumping back to the first page. by @yudshj - Preserve the actual text returned by failed tools in Trajectory lists, details, and copied output, including native tools and nested PTC calls. by @kermanx - Restore TypeScript and Python syntax highlighting for affected historical `run_code` records. by @kermanx - Use SSH for self-hosted Git plugin installation when HTTPS is unreadable and SSH is available. by @turtle2099 - Offer script approval and retry when installing Git plugins with prepare scripts instead of reporting only an unknown error. by @turtle2099 - Resolve configuration-project plugins using the project’s ESM rules for dependency subpaths, package imports, and self-references. by @shigma - Prevent a window-activating click on a Session title from accidentally opening rename on macOS, while preserving normal double-click rename. by @turtle2099 - Fix restricted sandbox commands failing to start when DSH runs as administrator or in Windows Sandbox, while preserving file-write and deletion restrictions. by @huoyaoyuan - Correct the Windows installed-app publisher and keep the application name separate from its version in uninstall listings. by @winewill - Improve Windows installer progress rendering, dragging, and activation, restore native minimize transitions, and trigger caption buttons on release inside the original button. by @winewill - Exit the Desktop Host immediately after acknowledging completed teardown so leftover event-loop handles do not block update installation. by @turtle2099 - Leave macOS fullscreen before Desktop update confirmation so failed installs recover the workspace; preserve tasks and show retry guidance if fullscreen exit times out. by @winewill - Show desktop update prompts in-window without raising native child windows for background results, and match prompts to the app’s light or dark theme. by @winewill - Keep conversation header menus close to their trigger buttons on macOS desktop. by @turtle2099 - Fix the native macOS directory picker initially appearing inactive and ignoring directory clicks. by @EricMoin ### Chores - Update to Cordis Core 4.1.0, Loader 1.1.0, and Include 1.1.0, unifying configuration access, entry changes, and persistence behavior. by @shigma, @imccyu - Provide unified Cordis Fiber access to raw configuration, candidate resolution, and effective configuration, used consistently by settings and hot reload. by @shigma - Raise the minimum supported Node.js version to 24.9. Upgrade older Node.js runtimes before upgrading DSH. by @tianyicui - Upgrade pi-ai to 1.3.0 with updated model catalogs, endpoints, and reasoning replay rules; malformed completed tool arguments fail the response before any tool executes. by @tianyicui - Default undeclared custom-model capacities to decimal 1M context and 128K output; smaller endpoints should set explicit capacities to avoid delayed compaction. by @LegGasai - Capture the step model before prompt assembly and pre-step and retain it through retries; plugins should select through agent.model rather than changing routes in agent/request. by @kermanx - Allow plugins to supply dynamic pi-ai headers using Session identity and request purpose, rejecting invalid headers before dispatch. by @LegGasai - Bring the TypeScript and Python SDKs in line with Web mode for file delivery, questions and callbacks, scheduling, skills, and context. Support native commands, plugin management, plan review, goal continuation, and operation approvals; restart the SDK to apply plugin changes. by @koalazf99, @LogosVeritas - Unify scheduled-task management across the Host with manual creation, direct editing, and prefilled prompts for creation in a Session. Retain drafts, support conflict review, and run tasks in reusable or new Sessions. by @ZiyaZhang, @Magolor - The Git worktree entry is included in Change requests and worktrees. Remove @deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-tool-worktree from dsh.profile.bundles if the standalone plugin was enabled. by @LegGasai - Ralph loop and Session search are no longer listed as experimental plugins. by @ZiyaZhang - Add `apply_patch`, disabled by default, to create, edit, delete, and move multiple files in one call, with changes available in Review. by @sjw1231, @CreatixChu - Disable read-before-write and external-change checks by default while retaining sandbox limits and Review. Profiles requiring the previous checks can explicitly restore the observation policy. by @sjw1231 - Activate tools conditionally per step with consistent model declarations, PTC bindings, and execution admission. Plugins must migrate tools.resolve/executable and prompt-assembly integration. by @LegGasai - Add a VM Script mode to Node PTC with top-level await, dynamic imports, and expression results, plus optional state retention across calls. Per-call execution remains the default; top-level return and using are unsupported. by @kermanx - Split native and PTC tool execution into Agent-scoped plugins; enable PTC through configuration overlays and migrate tools.mode and DSH_TOOLS_MODE usage. by @kermanx - Move the PTC Node control channel to birpc; upgrade self-deployed bootstraps and SSH helpers together, with SSH protocol increasing from 2 to 3. by @kermanx - Report caller-cancelled run_code calls in PTC Mode as ABORTED rather than CODE_RUN_FAILED. SDK and Session consumers must update cancellation handling. by @kermanx - Allow Web Fetch to access non-public addresses for proxies and internal networks; deployments must restrict network access separately. by @turtle2099 - Support experimental Auto review in Headless. by @tianyicui - Retrieve diagnostic reports for desktop startup failures, including a bounded history of recent plugin operations to help troubleshooting. by @winewill - Add independent Session APIs to read snapshots and continuously subscribe to Session event logs, execution state, and event-projection data. by @imccyu - Fix event publication and cleanup around Session creation, recovery, and disposal. Make initialization events available to live subscribers and wait for acquired resources to finish cleanup on cancellation. by @kermanx - Make Session Projection registration asynchronous, with plugins retaining a handle at startup. by @kermanx, @Magolor - Allow whole-unit JSON and SQLite storage to read explicitly declared compatible older versions and write in the current version format. by @Magolor - Rename Custom plugin markets to Custom plugin indexes. Discover reads user-added index files, and index generation excludes private versions, tags, and default-branch packages. by @turtle2099, @turtle1999 - Official bundle lists are now exported by @turtle2099 - Allow plugins to supply navigation icons for their settings pages, restoring the default icon when unloaded. by @Magolor - Show complete diagnostics and the Host log location for plugin failures, distinguishing installation failures from subsequent activation failures. by @kermanx Full Changelog: https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/compare/dsh-v0.2.1-rc.5...dsh-v0.2.2-rc.1

name: v0.2.2-alpha.3
body:
[中文](#cn-v0.2.2-alpha.3-5) | [English](#en-v0.2.2-alpha.3-5)

新增功能

- 支持统一右键与键盘菜单，覆盖会话、工作区和侧边栏，并支持开发者扩展 @std4453 - 文件预览支持常驻目录树和文件定位功能。 @yudshj - 实验性「变更请求与工作树」统一代码审查与工作树入口，支持通过可搜索文件树和逐文件导航查看本地及 PR 差异，将选中代码和评论交给 Agent，并跟踪检查与评审状态。 @LegGasai ### 体验优化 - 改善手机端侧栏导航与窄屏布局，保持会话标题稳定，并让模型目录输入和插件发现页操作完整可见。 @Stevring @Saafo @EricMoin - 菜单和浮窗优先保持在可见区域内，跟随浏览器缩放、平移和软键盘变化。 @Stevring - Trajectory 支持独立折叠子调用，保留父调用和摘要；搜索或跨视图定位时可展开对应子调用。 @kermanx - 优化对话中思考内容的展示，摘要、展开正文和翻译不再显示模型输出开头的签名前缀。 @LegGasai - 减少会话状态更新时的重复发布和目录处理开销，并降低长回复流式组装的运行时成本。 @liukx0205 @imccyu - 改善底部输入框的布局稳定性，减少输入、菜单展开和统计更新时的跳动。 @imccyu ### 问题修复 - 通过 pi-ai 接入的模型在会话图片超过请求数量上限时，自动省略最早的图片并继续请求，避免持续失败。 @turtle2099 - 修复 OpenCode 路由下自动审核在工具执行前失败的问题，审查请求携带对应会话的身份和用途。 @LegGasai - 修复 alpha.2 引入的空会话恢复后被当作「未命名」会话持续显示的问题，并恢复按最后提示时间排序。 @imccyu - 修复包含旧版子代理描述的历史会话无法打开，并导致会话搜索失败的问题。 @turtle2099 - 修复加载更早的已压缩会话历史后，聊天记录停止加载和更新的问题。 @turtle2099 - 聊天中的 Markdown 文件链接容忍无效行号，并支持行范围及行列后缀；无法定位时仍打开原文件，URL 保持为网页链接。 @kermanx - 文本和 Markdown 文件预览在刷新后保留阅读位置，文件暂时变短时也保留原位置，避免跳回第一页。 @yudshj - Trajectory 保留失败工具实际返回的文本，列表、详情和复制不再用合成错误信息替换它；原生工具和嵌套 PTC 调用使用相同规则。 @kermanx - 修复部分历史 `run_code` 记录的代码页缺少 TypeScript 或 Python 语法高亮的问题。 @kermanx ### 其他变更 - 同步 Cordis Core 至 4.0.0-rc.11、Loader 至 1.0.0-rc.8、Include 至 1.1.1，统一配置访问、条目变更和持久化行为。 @shigma @imccyu - pi-ai 支持插件按会话和请求用途提供动态请求头；无效请求头在请求发出前报错。 @LegGasai - 插件可为自己的设置页面提供导航图标，卸载后恢复默认图标。 @Magolor - 插件安装失败时显示完整诊断与 Host 日志入口，并区分安装失败和安装后启用失败。 @kermanx - 「Git 工作树」入口已合入「变更请求与工作树」，此前启用独立插件的用户需手动从 profile 的 dsh.profile.bundles 中移除 @deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-tool-worktree - 「自动化任务」改为统一的宿主级管理，支持手动创建、直接编辑和通过预填提示在会话中创建，保留编辑草稿并支持冲突复核，可选择复用或新建会话执行任务。 @ZiyaZhang @Magolor - 新增默认关闭的 `apply_patch` 工具，一次完成多文件新增、编辑、删除和移动，并在 Review 中查看变更。 @sjw1231 @CreatixChu - TypeScript 与 Python SDK 补齐原生命令和插件管理能力，支持计划审阅、目标续跑与操作审批；插件变更重启后生效。 @LogosVeritas @koalazf99 - macOS Computer Use 改用独立应用申请系统权限，打开对应系统设置并提供应用拖入引导，返回后刷新权限状态。 @CreatixChu - 文件修改的先读和外部修改防护默认关闭，沙箱限制和 Review 保持不变；需要原防护的 profile 可显式恢复观察策略。 @sjw1231 - 回退 alpha.2 中引入的跨行 `$$` 数学块的不稳定兼容解析。 @yudshj

New Features

- Unify mouse and keyboard context menus across Sessions, workspaces, and the sidebar, with support for developer extensions. by @std4453 - Keep a directory tree in file previews and locate the current file. by @yudshj - Unify code review and worktree access in the experimental change-request and worktree feature. Browse local and PR diffs through a searchable file tree and per-file navigation, quote selected code and comments to the Agent, and track checks and reviews. by @LegGasai ### Improvements - Improve mobile sidebar navigation and narrow-screen layouts, keeping Session titles stable and model-catalog inputs and plugin-discovery controls fully visible. by @Stevring, @Saafo, @EricMoin - Keep menus and floating panels within the visible viewport where possible, following browser zooming, panning, and on-screen keyboard changes. by @Stevring - Fold Trajectory subcalls independently while keeping their parent calls and summaries visible. Reveal matching subcalls through search or cross-view navigation. by @kermanx - Improve reasoning presentation in conversations by hiding leading signature metadata from summaries, expanded content, and translations. by @LegGasai - Reduce repeated publications and catalog processing during Session state updates, and lower runtime overhead when assembling streaming replies. by @liukx0205, @imccyu - Improve the layout stability of the docked composer, reducing movement during typing, menu expansion, and statistics updates. by @imccyu ### Bug Fixes - Continue pi-ai conversations that exceed the request image-count limit by offloading the oldest images, preventing repeated failures. by @turtle2099 - Fix Auto review failures before tool execution on OpenCode routes by supplying the reviewed Session identity and request purpose. by @LegGasai - Fix a regression introduced in alpha.2 that leaves resumed empty Sessions visible as untitled Sessions, and restore sorting by the last prompt time. by @imccyu - Restore opening historical Sessions with older subagent descriptors and fix the resulting Session search failures. by @turtle2099 - Fix chat history loading and live updates getting stuck after loading earlier compacted history. by @turtle2099 - Accept line ranges and line/column suffixes in Markdown file links, open the file when a location is invalid, and retain URLs as web links. by @kermanx - Retain reading position in text and Markdown previews across refreshes and temporary file shortening instead of jumping back to the first page. by @yudshj - Preserve the actual text returned by failed tools in Trajectory lists, details, and copied output, including native tools and nested PTC calls. by @kermanx - Restore TypeScript and Python syntax highlighting for affected historical `run_code` records. by @kermanx - Show the appropriate date, time, interval, and weekday controls when opening existing scheduled tasks, with field-specific correction guidance. Preserve timing rules when only the name or instruction changes, and retain original text for complex rules or values beyond control precision. by @Magolor ### Chores - Update Cordis Core to 4.0.0-rc.11, Loader to 1.0.0-rc.8, and Include to 1.1.1, unifying configuration access, entry changes, and persistence behavior. by @shigma, @imccyu - Allow plugins to supply dynamic pi-ai headers using Session identity and request purpose, rejecting invalid headers before dispatch. by @LegGasai - Allow plugins to supply navigation icons for their settings pages, restoring the default icon when unloaded. by @Magolor - Show complete diagnostics and the Host log location for plugin failures, distinguishing installation failures from subsequent activation failures. by @kermanx - The Git worktree entry is now included in change requests and worktrees. Users who enabled the standalone plugin must manually remove @deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-tool-worktree from dsh.profile.bundles in their profile. - Unify scheduled-task management across the Host with manual creation, direct editing, and prefilled prompts for creation in a Session. Retain drafts, support conflict review, and run tasks in reusable or new Sessions. by @ZiyaZhang, @Magolor - Add `apply_patch`, disabled by default, to create, edit, delete, and move multiple files in one call, with changes available in Review. by @sjw1231, @CreatixChu - Extend the TypeScript and Python SDKs with native commands and plugin management, supporting plan review, goal continuation, and operation approvals. Restart the SDK to apply plugin changes. by @LogosVeritas, @koalazf99 - Request macOS Computer Use permissions through a standalone app, opening the relevant system settings with drag-in guidance and refreshing permission status upon return. by @CreatixChu - Disable read-before-write and external-change checks by default while retaining sandbox limits and Review. Profiles requiring the previous checks can explicitly restore the observation policy. by @sjw1231 - Revert the unstable compatibility parsing for multiline `$$` display math introduced in alpha.2. by @yudshj Full Changelog: https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/compare/dsh-v0.2.2-alpha.2...dsh-v0.2.2-alpha.3

body:
[中文](#cn-v0.2.2-alpha.2-community) | [English](#en-v0.2.2-alpha.2-community)

新增功能

- 插件管理页支持展示富文本详情，并改善页面布局和导航行为。 @turtle1999, @turtle2099 - 插件管理支持更新第三方插件包；热更新失败时会尝试恢复旧版本。 @turtle1999, @turtle2099 - 支持将聊天文本作为引用插入输入框，并在发送后显示紧凑预览。 @lsdsjy, @imccyu - 支持将完整历史交会话复制为 Markdown，包含可用的原始日志路径。 @tianyicui - 工作步骤收起后保留全部助手文字回复，可切换为仅最终回答。 @imccyu - 新增日语、西班牙语、法语、德语、俄语和巴西葡萄牙语文案与界面配置。 @07akioni - 自动化任务页支持确认后一次清除全部已结束任务，保留进行中的任务。 @Chinesezjc - 新增实验性「`subagent_oar`工具」插件，可将独立任务交给本机 Codex 或 Claude CLI @tianyicui - 新增实验性「个性化推荐」插件，按需在回答下方提供官方插件启用卡片或个性化页面创建卡片。 @ZiyaZhang - 新增实验性「开发者工具 - 统计」插件，按轮次和步骤查看上下文、缓存、模型与工具耗时等统计。 @mektpoy - 新增实验性「变更请求与工作树」：可在独立 Git 工作树中运行会话，查看关联 PR 的状态和代码差异。 @LegGasai, @tianyicui ### 体验优化 - Preselect every recommended option in multiple-choice questions instead of only the first, while preserving single-choice and answered-card behavior. by @yudshj - Resolve relative chat file links from the Session working directory at click time so worktree Sessions do not open the original checkout. by @turtle2099 - Keep single tildes literal in Markdown and require double tildes for strikethrough. by @turtle2099 - Fix multiline $$ math rendering so opening-line math and following prose are preserved. by @Chinesezjc - Show the current local Markdown image in newly rendered messages and previews after the file is overwritten. by @turtle2099 - Fix bare URLs incorrectly including following Chinese punctuation and text in links. by @turtle2099 - Preserve backslash separators in Windows-path Markdown links and images so they resolve to the intended location. by @turtle2099 - Include whole-turn deliveries and writes in deliverable cards and closing-reply file links, even after the reply; present guidance tells agents to link files before waiting for user input. by @yudshj - Fix prolonged page freezes caused by syntax highlighting of certain struct definitions. by @yudshj - Fix pasted file and folder paths being highlighted only through their directory prefixes in the composer. by @turtle2099 - Pause the chat running clock during disconnection or reconnection and resume elapsed-time display after reconnecting. by @turtle2099 - Keep retained steering and follow-up input in log order before assistant output in Trajectory, including after refresh and history loading. by @kermanx - Use isolated, theme-backed sidebar drag previews to avoid capturing content behind rows while preserving native reordering. by @Stevring - Make settings-navigation hover visible in dark mode while retaining selected-state priority. by @turtle2099 - Expand and collapse long questions and option descriptions in place, with navigation and submission controls kept visible. by @yudshj - Prevent a window-activating click on a Session title from accidentally opening rename on macOS, while preserving normal double-click rename. by @turtle2099 - Preserve the sidebar file-tab strip's scroll position when selecting, opening, or closing tabs instead of restarting from the left edge. by @turtle2099 - Run ordinary conversation forks independently instead of treating them as subagents, while preserving creator relationships for real subagents. by @Dudu-0223 - Use SSH for self-hosted Git plugin installation when HTTPS is unreadable and SSH is available. by @turtle2099 - Offer script approval and retry when installing Git plugins with prepare scripts instead of reporting only an unknown error. by @turtle2099 - Approval messages explicitly state whether user approval is requested, avoiding ambiguity around the never policy. by @turtle2099 - Prevent history expansion from rewriting exclamation marks or causing persistent Bash command timeouts on macOS. by @grllll - Tell the model to continue after a skipped question without asking it again or treating the skip as permission. by @turtle2099 - Keep skills from healthy roots available when another skill root cannot be read, and report incomplete discovery. by @Dudu-0223 - Resolve configuration-project plugins using the project’s ESM rules for dependency subpaths, package imports, and self-references. by @shigma - Allow Web Fetch to read valid UTF-8 pages whose encoding declarations contain multiple labels including UTF-8. by @Dudu-0223 - Fix tool calls failing on unambiguous optional arguments by accepting an empty grep include. by @turtle1999 - Fix restricted sandbox commands failing to start when DSH runs as administrator or in Windows Sandbox, while preserving file-write and deletion restrictions. by @huoyaoyuan - Correct the Windows installed-app publisher and keep the application name separate from its version in uninstall listings. by @winewill - Improve Windows installer progress rendering, dragging, and activation, restore native minimize transitions, and trigger caption buttons on release inside the original button. by @winewill - Exit the Desktop Host immediately after acknowledging completed teardown so leftover event-loop handles do not block update installation. by @turtle2099 - Leave macOS fullscreen before Desktop update confirmation so failed installs recover the workspace; preserve tasks and show retry guidance if fullscreen exit times out. by @winewill - Show desktop update prompts in-window without raising native child windows for background results, and match prompts to the app’s light or dark theme. by @winewill - Keep conversation header menus close to their trigger buttons on macOS desktop. by @turtle2099 - Fix the native macOS directory picker initially appearing inactive and ignoring directory clicks. by @EricMoin ### Chores - Raise the minimum supported Node.js version to 24.9. Upgrade older Node.js runtimes before upgrading DSH. by @tianyicui - Provide SDK file delivery, questions, scheduling, skills, and context capabilities consistent with Web mode, with question callbacks and operation approval. by @koalazf99 - Fix event publication and cleanup around Session creation, recovery, and disposal. Make initialization events available to live subscribers and wait for acquired resources to finish cleanup on cancellation. by @kermanx - Add independent Session APIs to read snapshots and continuously subscribe to Session event logs, execution state, and event-projection data. by @imccyu - Migrate custom plugins to asynchronous retained Session-projection handles. Legacy registration disposers and key-based reads retain compatibility with deprecation notices; approval-state recovery requires the composition to provide sessionProjections and await service activation. by @kermanx, @Magolor - Allow whole-unit JSON and SQLite storage to read explicitly declared compatible older versions and write in the current version format. by @Magolor - Allow Web Fetch to access non-public addresses for proxies and internal networks; deployments must restrict network access separately. by @turtle2099 - Synchronize Cordis Timer with its upstream implementation; custom plugins must adapt to changed return values. by @shigma - Provide unified Cordis Fiber access to raw configuration, candidate resolution, and effective configuration, used consistently by settings and hot reload. by @shigma - Retrieve diagnostic reports for desktop startup failures, including a bounded history of recent plugin operations to help troubleshooting. by @winewill - Add system and application permission onboarding to macOS Computer Use, support long clicks, and improve application launching. Retain application permissions across restarts. by @CreatixChu, @koalazf99 - Support experimental Auto review in Headless. by @tianyicui - Keep Ralph loop and Session search bundled, but no longer list them among experimental plugins. by @ZiyaZhang - Upgrade pi-ai to 1.3.0 with updated model catalogs, endpoints, and reasoning replay rules; malformed completed tool arguments fail the response before any tool executes. by @tianyicui - Default undeclared custom-model capacities to decimal 1M context and 128K output; smaller endpoints should set explicit capacities to avoid delayed compaction. by @LegGasai - Capture the step model before prompt assembly and pre-step and retain it through retries; plugins should select through agent.model rather than changing routes in agent/request. by @kermanx - Rename Custom plugin markets to Custom plugin indexes. Discover reads user-added index files, and index generation excludes private versions, tags, and default-branch packages. by @turtle2099, @turtle1999 - Official bundle lists are now exported by @deepseek-ai/dsh-official-bundles; custom integrations must update imports from app-boot. by @turtle2099 - Activate tools conditionally per step with consistent model declarations, PTC bindings, and execution admission. Plugins must migrate tools.resolve/executable and prompt-assembly integration. by @LegGasai - Add a VM Script mode to Node PTC with top-level await, dynamic imports, and expression results, plus optional state retention across calls. Per-call execution remains the default; top-level return and using are unsupported. by @kermanx - Split native and PTC tool execution into Agent-scoped plugins; enable PTC through configuration overlays and migrate tools.mode and DSH_TOOLS_MODE usage. by @kermanx - Move the PTC Node control channel to birpc; upgrade self-deployed bootstraps and SSH helpers together, with SSH protocol increasing from 2 to 3. by @kermanx - Report caller-cancelled run_code calls in PTC Mode as ABORTED rather than CODE_RUN_FAILED. SDK and Session consumers must update cancellation handling. by @kermanx Full Changelog: [dsh-v0.2.1-rc.4...dsh-v0.2.2-alpha.2](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/compare/dsh-v0.2.1-rc.4...dsh-v0.2.2-alpha.2)

name: v0.2.1-rc.1
body:
[中文](#cn-v0.2.1-rc.1-community) | [English](#en-v0.2.1-rc.1-community) 作为 `0.2.1` 系列的首个候选版本，本版本汇总了自 `v0.2.0-rc.2` 以来的主要用户和开发者相关变更。

新增功能

- 允许用户从“自定义插件索引源”中发现和安装插件。 @turtle1999 - 插件管理页新增「让 Agent 创建插件」入口，可保留草稿进入创造模式；发送需求后才开始执行。 @ZiyaZhang - 支持插件启用、停用、卸载及更新后的依赖同步；启用热重载时，更新或重新安装的可替换插件直接生效，无法热重载时提示重启。 @imccyu, @turtle1999 - 可选插件支持极简模式，Official 插件列表支持按需安装与当前发布版对应的 Claude Code 和 Codex 组合包，并可用于 headless、SDK 和 ACP profile。 @tianyicui, @turtle2099 - 新增实验性插件的 Session 状态记录接口，供插件写入和读取自己的会话记录。 @tianyicui - 新增实验性 Claude Code Mods 兼容层。目前阶段的主要目的是验证 Claude Code Mods API 功能大致为 DeepSeek Harness 插件的一个子集，而非为用户提供实际的完整兼容性。 @tianyicui - 新增实验性开发者工具组合包，提供会话原始日志、聊天分组与正文的双向定位，以及内嵌 NodeJS 调试工具；内嵌 DevTools 目前使用英文界面。 @imccyu, @turtle2099 - 新增实验性思考过程机器翻译插件，可在插件页启用，选择 Bing、Google 或付费 DeepSeek Flash。 @tianyicui, @ZiyaZhang, @imccyu - 新增实验性 Git Worktrees 插件，可在插件页启用，由 Agent 创建并进入独立的 Git checkout。 @tianyicui, @turtle2099 - 自定义模型 API 支持通过UI中配置各模型的推理等级，无需手动修改配置文件。 @LegGasai - pi-ai 路由支持按模型能力处理会话中的系统提示词更新，以及工具的动态新增和移除。 @Tuyixiang - 极简模式支持读取图片和自动压缩长对话，Web 与桌面端可通过 /compact 指令手动压缩上下文。 @LogosVeritas - 全局指令支持读取共享 agents 目录中的 AGENTS.md，可通过 DSH_AGENTS_HOME 指定目录。 @tianyicui - 新增 working_directory 工具，并为 TypeScript/Python SDK 提供会话工作目录的读取和切换接口。 @tianyicui - SSH 新增独立可执行的 helper 运行时，支持远端文件操作、进程、终端、沙箱和 Node PTC。 @LegGasai - Web 版支持在本机 HTTP 访问时登录 DeepSeek 账号。 @lsdsjy - 支持识别已发送消息中的密钥和令牌，并默认脱敏按需查看。 @ZiyaZhang - 新会话支持预填未发送的提示；恢复草稿或切换工作区时保留文件、目录和会话引用。 @imccyu - 新增工作步骤收起时机设置，可选择回答结束后收起，或在下一条普通消息到来时收起。 @imccyu - Markdown 文件预览将 YAML 头部元数据显示为清晰的字段列表。 @turtle2099 ### 体验优化 - 改善自动化任务详情在窄窗口中的布局，关联会话入口会按可用空间收起为图标。 @turtle2099 - 子智能体可通过配置选用独立 Agent Preset 预设，统一设置角色和工具； @grllll, @Dudu-0223 - 改进子智能体的委派与等待指引：达到委派层数上限时提前提示，等待子任务期间不再消耗新的目标执行轮次。 @ZiyaZhang, @turtle1999 - 组合包详情页显示代码来源和当前版本，便于查看安装来源及重装所需的信息。 @turtle1999 - 插件安装结果显示实际安装版本；因新版本冷却策略安装较旧版本时，提供说明和精确版本安装方式。 @turtle2099 - 工具调用在准备阶段即可显示已到达的命令说明、文件路径和内容生成进度。 @imccyu - Shell 和插件安装详情支持横向查看及复制完整命令；后台 Bash 调用可展开输入和启动回执。 @tianyicui - Web 终端更可靠地处理连续输入、粘贴和尺寸调整，并保留进程退出前的最后输出。 @LegGasai - PTC Mode 的 Node 执行环境新增可选的 in-memory 模式，多次运行代码可复用变量、函数和已导入模块。 @CreatixChu - 改善大量会话的列表加载与 @ 会话搜索体验。 @turtle1999, @imccyu - 优化自动会话标题生成，对同主题的追问、补充和继续请求保留已有合适标题。 @tianyicui, @ZiyaZhang - 侧栏 Fork 和子代理目录浏览新增迁移提示，遇到需要迁移的会话时引导用户先打开原会话。 @imccyu - 优化侧栏展开规则，让运行中和等待回应的会话更容易找到；会话菜单支持复制会话 ID。 @turtle1999, @imccyu - 支持分别设置界面正文、代码与工具输出、侧栏终端的字体和字号；桌面端可通过 Cmd/Ctrl + 加号或减号统一调整字号。 @turtle2099, @koalazf99 - 优化会话和工作区的悬停操作，统一卡片与菜单样式，并改善页头排列及插件页、自动化任务页的窄窗口布局。 @Yifffan, @Kingwl - 语音输入新增麦克风选择，可在插件详情页选择输入设备，并查看所选设备的实时输入电平。 @yudshj - 允许远程主机访问的 Web 配置使用页面内目录选择器，不再在服务器上弹出原生目录对话框。 @oraluben - 优化含超长源码行的文件预览性能，超长行使用无高亮文本展示，普通行继续进行语法高亮。 @turtle2099 - Office 文档任务按需加载编辑、渲染和导出指引，减少简单修改及 PDF 导出后的无关检查与预览，并避免在回复中引用已删除的预览图。 @yudshj - DeepSeek 账号的模型列表随账号可用模型更新，并隐藏当前客户端版本不支持的模型。 @LegGasai - 模型设置更清楚地提示凭据来源和检测状态，支持按需显示输入的 API Key。 @Magolor ### 问题修复 - 目标编辑支持多行文本和 Shift+Enter 换行，并改善目标与排队消息编辑器的中文输入及宽度适配。 @turtle2099 - 修复目标任务停止、恢复并再次停止后，新消息滞留队列的问题。 @turtle2099 - 修复 Trajectory 将等待、流式输出或重试中的请求标为完成，以及压缩任务提前显示结果的问题。 @turtle2099, @kermanx - 修复后台工作流仍在运行，却因父级工具步骤或对话轮次正常结束而被标为已中断的问题。 @turtle2099 - 恢复可继续子代理输入栏的图片粘贴和拖放，支持运行中追加图片和完成后发送图片续发消息。 @ZiyaZhang - 应用意外退出后，未完成的任务会明确显示“任务已停止”，避免被误认为正常完成。 @turtle2099 - 修复部分 Bash、PowerShell 和文件修改记录无法展开输出或差异的问题。 @turtle2099 - 修复凭据、配置和技能文件监听器关闭后的未捕获异常，以及 Agent 关闭时资源提前释放的问题。 @tianyicui, @kermanx - 修复部分 Windows 环境下，持久 PowerShell 在大量输出滚屏后迟迟无法结束当前调用的问题。 @Chinesezjc - 修复 Windows Desktop 终端退出后，PTY 后台工作进程未随之清理的问题。 @winewill - 减少 Linux 下启动命令前的重复检查，降低命令启动开销，并改善较旧 systemd 环境的兼容性。 @imccyu - 修复命令执行失败时，未呈现有效的状态信息。 @yudshj - 减少新建与恢复多个终端时的重复查询，并避免失效终端在切换面板后反复重试。 @LegGasai - 改善 PTC Mode 中缺失的部分指引，并统一 SDK、Web 和 headless 的模型身份说明。 @koalazf99 - 关闭代码工作视图后仍可选择标准、创造和自定义模式；内置 PTC／极简默认值改为标准，已有会话保持原模式。 @ZiyaZhang - 修复启停插件时其他插件的样式被移除、需要刷新页面才能恢复的问题。 @turtle2099 - 启用开发目录监听后，HMR 可刷新包入口和依赖映射配置，并正确重载仍在运行的原入口。 @imccyu - 修复在插件页启用或停用插件后，已打开会话的 `/` 菜单未更新技能列表的问题。 @grllll - 登录请求未收到响应时显示网络检查提示，便于区分连接问题与其他登录失败。 @lsdsjy - 修复模型响应流停止输出、且底层传输不响应取消时，请求超过空闲超时仍一直挂起的问题。 @tianyicui - 修复插件包元信息不可读，或辅助请求扩展准备失败时，整个 DeepSeek 请求被阻断的问题。 @turtle1999, @turtle2099 - 修复模型设置刷新期间仍可基于旧数据编辑或删除配置，导致刚保存的选择未出现在编辑器中的问题。 @tianyicui - 凭据文件中出现 DSH 不使用的额外字段时，不再阻止应用启动。 @turtle2099 - 桌面端默认使用系统分配的端口，避免 Windows 保留端口范围导致应用无法启动。 @turtle2099 - 修复展开右侧栏后，会话标题栏中的后台任务列表被侧栏遮挡或裁切的问题。 @turtle2099 - 修复 Windows Desktop 图片预览遮罩及关闭按钮与标题栏重叠、侧栏按钮悬停圆角不一致的问题。 @turtle2099 - 修复 Windows 安装器对磁盘根目录的校验，拒绝带重复末尾路径分隔符的根目录写法。 @tianyicui - 修复 macOS 应用的小尺寸 Finder 图标，以及复制和替换应用提示中的图标损坏问题。 @07akioni - 修复 Windows 和 Linux 下右侧栏收起时，在输入框按 Page Up 导致整个界面向左偏移的问题。 @imccyu - 修复侧栏列表重排或重新显示后，会话加载动画不同步的问题。 @turtle2099 - 修复 /goal、/plan 等命令与参数交界处的输入异常及草稿与显示不一致，支持整体选中、删除命令，并在撤销或刷新页面后恢复。 @LegGasai - 修复切换会话、收起工作过程或发送后续消息时，对话区域出现大块空白、滚动跳动的问题。 @imccyu - 修复重启应用后部分会话无法继续，以及切换到 DeepSeek 后因历史消息兼容问题导致请求失败的情况。 @imccyu, @yudshj - 修复 macOS 添加工作区时目录选择器无法粘贴目录路径，以及取消选择仍添加工作区的问题。 @turtle2099 - 修复原预设被删除或调整后，恢复空白会话、切换工作区可能失败的问题。 @LegGasai - 修复卸载会话存储插件时，最后的会话记录可能丢失的问题。 @turtle1999 - 修复本地 SenseVoice 语音识别开启 VAD 后，录音开头被截断、首字或音节丢失的问题。 @yudshj - 修复远程 Web 在网络拥塞时被误判为断线，以及刷新后语言、主题等偏好丢失的问题。 @turtle2099, @oraluben ### 其他变更 - API Key 读取优先级变更：Web端/桌面端优先采用已保存的凭据；headless 默认改用环境变量和 .env，不读取已保存的密钥。 @Magolor - 移除运行时 invariant 插件及各包的 `./invariant` 导出；使用这些诊断入口的开发者需相应调整扩展或自定义 profile。 @turtle2099 - 子路径插件不再读取独立的 `package.json`，显示文本和图标须通过对应子路径导出；插件开发模板同步补齐本地化信息与图标。 @turtle1999 - 第三方插件的版本兼容性优先按 `engines.dsh` 判断；未声明时沿用原有规则。插件作者需检查声明是否覆盖支持的 DSH 版本。 @turtle1999 - 输入区统计扩展拆为 `activity` 和 `usage` 两个独立入口；覆盖旧 `stats` 整行的插件需要更新注册 ID。 @turtle1999 - 为用户消息、文本与图片展示、新会话页及模型选择器添加扩展位，支持插件定制对应内容。 @imccyu, @LegGasai - 自动化任务改为 Web 内置能力，提醒工具按模式提供：标准、创造和 PTC 模式可用，极简模式和子代理不可用；旧实验组合包选择会自动清理，已有任务保留。 @Chinesezjc, @turtle1999 - 关闭计划审阅以补充修改意见时，直接结束当前轮次并等待用户反馈，避免额外调用模型。 @turtle2099 - 统一子代理执行与完成通知，工具立即返回 child ID；自定义 SDK runtime 需支持 session/wait。 @Dudu-0223 - Agent Team 消息改为直接投递目标 Inbox，移除独立 outbox、自动重试和重发去重；相关配置与结果字段需迁移。 @Dudu-0223 - Python PTC 接入 Session 文件沙箱策略；自定义组合需提供 sandbox 和 sandboxPolicy 服务。 @tianyicui - 移除工具展示的 both 混合模式，仅保留 native 和 ptc；使用旧模式的配置与 API 调用需要更新。 @tianyicui - 移除 agent-instructions 插件逐行 dshHome 配置，指令目录改从进程的 DSH_HOME 或默认目录读取。 @tianyicui - 默认 SDK profile 从固定的编程 Agent 改为通用 AI Agent 身份，适用于一般任务。 @Dudu-0223 - 使用 --from-default-profile 重建已有自定义配置时，会替换该配置及其插件和设置。 @turtle2099 - TypeScript 和 Python SDK 支持 resume 功能，恢复已保存的会话，继续使用原有会话 ID 和工作目录。 @koalazf99 - Python SDK 的 Office 引擎和完整创作环境改为按需下载。 @yudshj - 完善网关授权与连接机制，支持按调用方身份控制资源访问，并独立管理 API 连接及其交互参与方式。 @imccyu - Web 支持通过 `--public-url` 指定显示、打开及提供给模型的对外访问地址，支持带路径前缀的反向代理入口。 @oraluben - Web 支持绑定指定的 IPv4/IPv6 地址，并通过 --tls-cert 和 --tls-key 配置原生 HTTPS 监听。 @oraluben - pi-ai 更新至 1.0.2，包含上游模型目录更新和适配器修复。 @tianyicui - 更新第三方模型支持；Azure 提供方名称统一为 azure，使用旧名称 azure-openai-responses 的提供方配置需迁移。 @LegGasai - 更新运行时工具、MCP 协议、图片处理和客户端渲染依赖，纳入兼容版本的安全修复。 @tianyicui This first release candidate for 0.2.1 summarizes the major user- and developer-facing changes since v0.2.0-rc.2.

New Features

- Discover and install plugins from custom plugin index sources. by @turtle1999 - Add a “Let Agent create a plugin” entry to plugin management. It opens Creator mode while preserving the draft and starts work only after the request is sent. by @ZiyaZhang - Support dependency synchronization when plugins are enabled, disabled, uninstalled, or updated. With hot reload enabled, replaceable plugins take effect directly after an update or reinstallation; changes that cannot be hot-reloaded request a restart. by @imccyu, @turtle1999 - Support optional plugins in Minimal mode. The Official plugin catalog offers on-demand installation of Claude Code and Codex bundles matching the current release, for use in headless, SDK, and ACP profiles. by @tianyicui, @turtle2099 - Add Session state-record APIs for experimental plugins to write and read their own session records. by @tianyicui - Add an experimental Claude Code Mods compatibility layer. At this stage, the main goal is to verify that the Claude Code Mods API's capabilities are broadly a subset of what DeepSeek Harness plugins can do, rather than to offer users complete, practical compatibility. by @tianyicui - Add an experimental Developer Tools bundle with raw session logs, bidirectional navigation between chat groups and the conversation, and embedded NodeJS debugging tools. The embedded DevTools currently uses an English interface. by @imccyu, @turtle2099 - Add an experimental reasoning translation plugin, enabled from the Plugins page with Bing, Google, or paid DeepSeek Flash as the provider. by @tianyicui, @ZiyaZhang, @imccyu - Add an experimental Git Worktrees plugin that can be enabled on the Plugins page for Agents to create and enter separate Git checkouts. by @tianyicui, @turtle2099 - Configure reasoning levels for individual custom API models in the UI without editing configuration files manually. by @LegGasai - Support in-conversation system prompt updates and dynamic tool additions and removals on pi-ai routes according to model capabilities. by @Tuyixiang - Minimal mode can read images and automatically compact long conversations. Web and Desktop users can run the /compact command to compact context manually. by @LogosVeritas - Load global instructions from AGENTS.md in the shared agents directory, with DSH_AGENTS_HOME available to select its location. by @tianyicui - Add the working_directory tool and TypeScript/Python SDK APIs for reading and changing a session’s working directory. by @tianyicui - Add standalone executable SSH helper runtimes supporting remote file operations, processes, terminals, sandboxing, and Node PTC. by @LegGasai - The Web app supports DeepSeek account sign-in when accessed over local HTTP. by @lsdsjy - Detect keys and tokens in sent messages and mask them by default, with an option to reveal them. by @ZiyaZhang - Support unsent initial prompts for new sessions and preserve file, folder, and session references when restoring drafts or moving them between workspaces. by @imccyu - Add a setting to collapse work details either when the response finishes or when the next regular message arrives. by @imccyu - Display YAML frontmatter as a readable field list in Markdown file previews. by @turtle2099 ### Improvements - Improve Automation task details in narrow windows by collapsing the linked-session action to an icon when space is limited. by @turtle2099 - Configure spawned subagents with independent Agent Presets to manage their roles and tools together. by @grllll, @Dudu-0223 - Improve subagent delegation and waiting guidance: announce delegation depth limits in advance and wait for running subtasks before starting another goal round. by @ZiyaZhang, @turtle1999 - Show a bundle’s code source and current version in its details, making installation and reinstallation information easier to find. by @turtle1999 - Show the version actually installed and explain how to request an exact version when pnpm’s release-age policy selects an older release. by @turtle2099 - Show available command descriptions, file paths, and content-generation progress while tool calls are still preparing. by @imccyu - Support scrolling and copying full commands in Shell and plugin installation details, and expand background Bash inputs and launch receipts. by @tianyicui - Handle continuous input, pastes, and resizing more reliably in the Web terminal, and preserve the final output when a process exits. by @LegGasai - The Node runtime for PTC Mode adds an optional in-memory mode that reuses variables, functions, and imported modules across code executions. by @CreatixChu - Improve large session list loading and @ session search. by @turtle1999, @imccyu - Improve automatic session titles by retaining adequate titles for same-topic follow-ups, additional details, and requests to continue. by @tianyicui, @ZiyaZhang - Add migration guidance to sidebar forks and subagent catalog browsing, directing users to open the original session when migration is required. by @imccyu - Improve sidebar expansion so running sessions and sessions awaiting a response are easier to find. Session menus support copying the session ID. by @turtle1999, @imccyu - Choose fonts and sizes separately for interface text, code and tool output, and sidebar terminals. On Desktop, use Cmd/Ctrl + plus or minus to adjust font sizes together. by @turtle2099, @koalazf99 - Refine session and workspace hover interactions, unify card and menu styling, and improve header ordering and narrow-window layouts on plugin and automation pages. by @Yifffan, @Kingwl - Add microphone selection to voice input, with an input-device selector and live levels for the selected device in plugin details. by @yudshj - Use the in-page directory picker in Web configurations that allow remote hosts, instead of opening a native directory dialog on the server. by @oraluben - Improve previews of files containing overlong source lines, rendering those lines without syntax colors while regular lines retain highlighting. by @turtle2099 - Load Office editing, rendering, and export guidance as needed, reduce unrelated checks and previews for simple edits and after PDF export, and avoid referencing deleted preview images in replies. by @yudshj - Keep the DeepSeek account model list up to date with the models available to the account, while hiding models unsupported by the current client version. by @LegGasai - Model settings show clearer credential sources and detection status, and let users reveal an entered API key. by @Magolor ### Bug Fixes - Support multiline goal editing with Shift+Enter, and improve IME handling and resizing in goal and queued-message editors. by @turtle2099 - Fix new messages remaining queued after stopping, resuming, and stopping a goal-driven task again. by @turtle2099 - Fix Trajectory marking waiting, streaming, or retrying requests as completed and showing results before compaction tasks finish. by @turtle2099, @kermanx - Fix background workflows being marked interrupted while still running after their parent tool step or conversation turn ends normally. by @turtle2099 - Restore image paste and drop in continuable subagent composers, including images sent while running and follow-ups after completion. by @ZiyaZhang - Tasks interrupted by an application exit now show “Task stopped” instead of appearing to have completed normally. by @turtle2099 - Fix some Bash, PowerShell, and file-mutation records failing to expand their output or diff. by @turtle2099 - Fix uncaught errors after credential, configuration, and skill watchers close, and premature resource release during Agent shutdown. by @tianyicui, @kermanx - Fix persistent PowerShell calls failing to settle promptly after large amounts of output scroll in some Windows environments. by @Chinesezjc - Fix PTY worker processes remaining after a terminal exits in Windows Desktop. by @winewill - Reduce repeated checks before launching commands on Linux, lowering startup overhead and improving compatibility with older systemd environments. by @imccyu - Fix failed commands not displaying useful status information. by @yudshj - Reduce redundant queries when creating or restoring multiple terminals, and prevent failed terminals from retrying repeatedly when switching panels. by @LegGasai - Improve incomplete guidance in PTC Mode, and align model identity prompts across SDK, Web, and headless profiles. by @koalazf99 - Keep Standard, Creator, and custom modes available when coding view is disabled. Built-in PTC or Minimal defaults change to Standard, while existing sessions retain their mode. by @ZiyaZhang - Fix toggling a plugin removing styles owned by other plugins until the page is refreshed. by @turtle2099 - With development-directory watching enabled, refresh package-entry and dependency-mapping configuration while continuing to reload the entry that is already running. by @imccyu - Fix the skill list in an open Session’s `/` menu not updating after a plugin is enabled or disabled on the Plugins page. by @grllll - Show a network-check message when a sign-in request receives no response, distinguishing connection problems from other sign-in failures. by @lsdsjy - Fix requests remaining stuck beyond the idle timeout when a model response stream stops producing output and its transport ignores cancellation. by @tianyicui - Fix entire DeepSeek requests being blocked when plugin package metadata cannot be read or auxiliary request-extension preparation fails. by @turtle1999, @turtle2099 - Fix editing or deleting model settings from stale data during refresh, including newly saved selections missing from the editor. by @tianyicui - Extra fields that DSH does not use in the credentials file no longer prevent the application from starting. by @turtle2099 - Let the operating system assign the Desktop port by default, avoiding startup failures caused by reserved port ranges on Windows. by @turtle2099 - Fix the background job list in the session header being obscured or clipped when the right sidebar is expanded. by @turtle2099 - Fix Windows Desktop image-preview masks and close buttons overlapping the caption, and inconsistent sidebar-button hover corners. by @turtle2099 - Fix drive-root validation in the Windows installer to reject root paths containing repeated trailing separators. by @tianyicui - Fix corrupt small Finder icons for the macOS app and icons shown in application copy and replacement dialogs. by @07akioni - Fix Page Up in a text input shifting the entire interface to the left on Windows and Linux when the right sidebar is collapsed. by @imccyu - Keep session loading animations synchronized after sidebar rows move or become visible again. by @turtle2099 - Fix input errors and draft/display mismatches between commands such as /goal or /plan and their arguments. Commands can be selected and deleted as a whole, and restored after undo or a page reload. by @LegGasai - Fix large blank areas and scroll jumps when switching sessions, collapsing work details, or sending follow-up messages. by @imccyu - Fix failures when continuing some sessions after an application restart, and history compatibility errors when switching to DeepSeek. by @imccyu, @yudshj - Fix pasting directory paths into the directory picker when adding a workspace on macOS, and prevent cancelled selections from adding a workspace. by @turtle2099 - Fix failures when restoring a blank session or switching workspaces after its original preset was removed or changed. by @LegGasai - Fix a case where final session records could be lost while unloading the session storage plugin. by @turtle1999 - Fix clipped recording onsets and missing initial words or syllables in local SenseVoice transcription with VAD enabled. by @yudshj - Fix false disconnects during network congestion and lost language, theme, and other preferences after refreshing a remote Web client. by @turtle2099, @oraluben ### Chores - Change API key precedence: Web and Desktop prioritize saved credentials. Headless uses environment variables and .env files by default, without reading saved keys. by @Magolor - Remove runtime invariant plugins and package `./invariant` exports. Developers using these diagnostic entry points need to update their extensions or custom profiles accordingly. by @turtle2099 - Stop reading separate `package.json` files for subpath plugins; display text and icons must use the corresponding subpath exports. Plugin-development templates now include localized metadata and icons. by @turtle1999 - Third-party plugin compatibility prioritizes `engines.dsh` when declared and otherwise uses the existing rules. Plugin authors should check that the declared range covers their supported DSH versions. by @turtle1999 - Split composer statistics into separate `activity` and `usage` extension entries. Plugins replacing the former `stats` row must update their registered IDs. by @turtle1999 - Add extension points for user messages, text and image rendering, the new-session page, and the model selector, allowing plugins to customize their content. by @imccyu, @LegGasai - Make Automation tasks part of Web, with reminder tools scoped to Standard, Creator, and PTC modes. Minimal mode and subagents do not receive them. Retired experimental-bundle selections are cleaned up while existing tasks are preserved. by @Chinesezjc, @turtle1999 - End the current turn and wait for user feedback when a plan review is dismissed to request changes, avoiding an extra model call. by @turtle2099 - Unify subagent execution and completion notifications, with tools returning child IDs immediately. Custom SDK runtimes must support session/wait. by @Dudu-0223 - Deliver Agent Team messages directly to the target Inbox, removing the separate outbox, automatic retries, and resend deduplication. Migrate affected configuration and result fields. by @Dudu-0223 - Apply Session filesystem sandbox policies to Python PTC; custom compositions require sandbox and sandboxPolicy services. by @tianyicui - Remove the both mixed tool-presentation mode, leaving native and ptc. Update configurations and API calls that use the removed mode. by @tianyicui - Remove the per-row dshHome setting from agent-instructions and resolve instruction directories from the process DSH_HOME or its default. by @tianyicui - Change the default SDK profile from a fixed coding-agent persona to a general AI Agent identity for general-purpose tasks. by @Dudu-0223 - Using --from-default-profile to recreate an existing custom profile replaces that profile, including its plugins and settings. by @turtle2099 - The TypeScript and Python SDKs support session resume, restoring saved sessions with their original session IDs and working directories. by @koalazf99 - The Python SDK’s Office engine and full authoring environment are now downloaded on demand. by @yudshj - Improve gateway authorization and connection management with caller-based resource access control and independent API connections whose participation in user interactions can be configured. by @imccyu - Add `--public-url` for the Web address shown to users, opened in the browser, and supplied to the model, including reverse-proxy URLs with a path prefix. by @oraluben - Allow Web to bind to a specific IPv4/IPv6 address and configure native HTTPS listeners through --tls-cert and --tls-key. by @oraluben - Update pi-ai to 1.0.2, including upstream model-catalog updates and adapter fixes. by @tianyicui - Update third-party model support and rename the Azure provider to azure. Provider configurations using azure-openai-responses must be migrated. by @LegGasai - Update runtime utilities, MCP protocol integrations, image processing, and client-rendering dependencies with compatible security fixes. by @tianyicui Full Changelog: [dsh-v0.2.0-rc.2...dsh-v0.2.1-rc.1](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/compare/dsh-v0.2.0-rc.2...dsh-v0.2.1-rc.1)

## 中文

### 新增功能

- 自定义模型 API 支持通过UI中配置各模型的推理等级，无需手动修改配置文件。 by @LegGasai
- 允许用户从“自定义插件索引源”中发现和安装插件。 by @turtle1999 

### 问题修复

- 修复命令与参数交界处输入异常的问题。支持整体选中/删除，并在撤销或刷新页面后恢复。 by @LegGasai
- 改进 Office 文件交付：避免在回复中引用已删除的预览图，减少 PDF 导出后不必要的工具查找和额外检查。 by @yudshj
- 修复启用开发者工具后，仍需刷新页面才能打开工具面板的问题。 by @imccyu
- 减少 Linux 下启动命令前的重复检查，降低命令启动开销，并改善较旧 systemd 环境的兼容性。 by @imccyu
- 修复命令执行失败时，未呈现有效的状态信息。 by @yudshj

### 其他变更

- 第三方插件的版本兼容性优先按 `engines.dsh` 判断；未声明时沿用原有规则。插件作者需检查声明是否覆盖支持的 DSH 版本。 by @turtle1999

---

## English

### New Features

- Configure reasoning levels for individual custom API models in the UI without editing configuration files manually. by @LegGasai
- Discover and install plugins from custom plugin index sources. by @turtle1999

### Bug Fixes

- Fix input glitches between a command and its arguments. Commands can be selected and deleted as a whole, and restored after undo or a page reload. by @LegGasai
- Improve Office file delivery: avoid referencing deleted preview images in replies and reduce unnecessary tool searches and extra checks after PDF export. by @yudshj
- Fix Developer Tools requiring a page reload before its panel can open after being enabled. by @imccyu
- Reduce repeated checks before launching commands on Linux, lowering startup overhead and improving compatibility with older systemd environments. by @imccyu
- Fix failed commands not displaying useful status information. by @yudshj

### Other Changes

- Third-party plugin compatibility prioritizes `engines.dsh` when declared and otherwise uses the existing rules. Plugin authors should check that the declared range covers their supported DSH versions. by @turtle1999
